reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The storage overrides for configuring per-broker storage class are not supported anymore", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Storage overrides that set a storage class per broker are no longer supported, so those per-broker storage class settings are not honoured.
consequence.remediation: Replace storage overrides with multiple KafkaNodePool resources, each using a different storage class, following the Strimzi documentation on migrating from storage overrides.

proposed.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0, storage overrides for setting a storage class per broker are no longer supported; use multiple KafkaNodePool resources, each with its own storage class, instead.
